text:
maria: Northbridge weekly health check — quick p95/p99 split by route & model, live (stream) vs batch (sync). Chart: https://charts.redwood/northbridge/2026/wk12 :eyes:

maria: Topline: overall usage +12% w/w, spend +9%. Latency: p95 stable, p99 spike on /assistant-stream and /longform-generate for Llama-70q during Tue lunch window.
aj: saw the spike ~2026-03-24T11:20-12:05Z, aligns with several concurrent long sessions (avg ~1.2k tokens/session).
aj: quick PromQL I ran to surface the tail:
```
max_over_time(latency_p99{acct="northbridge",route=~"/assistant-.*|/longform-.*",model=~".*70.*"}[1h])
```
sam: error rate overall steady, but tail errors (429 throttles) increase when GPU queue >8. logs show `gpu_queue_depth > 8 -> 429` clusters at same time.
jenna: can we try fallback to smaller model for very long sequences? suggested policy: if input_tokens > 800 -> route to model-x-30b. Should reduce p99 and cost.
maria: agree. aj, can you run a 5% canary to model-x-30b for /longform-generate and compare p99 for streaming vs batch?
aj: on it. Planning canary Wed 2026-03-25T14:00Z, 5% traffic. Will capture p95/p99, success rate, and spend delta. Posting dashboard link when ready.
cs-bot: scheduled canary: northbridge /longform-generate -> model-x-30b 5% at 2026-03-25T14:00Z.
sam: also recommend increasing prefix/KV cache TTL for /longform-generate from 30s -> 120s to help repeated patterns in sessions. Could be a low-effort win.
aj: note — streaming path bypasses some KV caching due to chunked frames. We may need a small runtime tweak to re-enable prefix cache for streaming frames.
maria: action items:
- aj -> run canary + post p95/p99 dashboard by Wed EOD (include stream vs batch breakdown)
- sam -> draft fallback routing config + cost delta estimate
- jenna -> prepare renewal-risk note for AE and include mitigation plan
jenna: I'll draft the note and loop in AE @nate for visibility.
maria: thanks. We'll reconvene next Mon for follow-up. :thumbsup:
